Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggextreme 0.1.0

  • First release.
  • Bar chart races: ggrace(), race_frame(), race_size() and animate_race(), with country flags on the bars.
  • Interactive causal diagrams with ggcausal(), including the paths an adjustment set leaves open.
  • Network meta-analysis: network plots with ggnma(), league tables with ggleague(), both showing where each estimate’s evidence comes from, and the CINeMA family cinema_judge(), cinema_league(), cinema_contribution(), cinema_clinical(), cinema_incoherence() and cinema_network().
  • Meta-analysis: forest plots with ggmeta() and animate_meta(), and funnel plots with ggfunnel().
  • Trials and survival: Kaplan-Meier plots with ggkm() and animate_km(), swimmer plots with ggswimmer() and responder thresholds with ggresponder().
  • Explorers: ggdiagnostic() for test cutoffs, ggsensitivity() for unmeasured confounding and ggmultiverse() for a multiverse of analyses.
  • Nomograms of regression models with ggnomogram() and nomogram_predict(), and choropleth maps with ggchoropleth() and animate_choropleth().
  • graph_widget(), graph_plot() and graph_save() for every interactive graph.

Developed by Ahmad Sofi-Mahmudi.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
